contract: DESIGN.md: Mesa de despacho proposal; static work-network mockup with explicit fictional data, local interactions, desktop1440x1000 and mobile375x812. See contractDetails for limits.

accessibility.evidence: Bounded browser checks: Enter selects graph element; view tabs and inspector labels present; mobile Close and Escape close the drawer and return focus. Full accessibility/contrast certification was not performed.

responsive.evidence: Chromium at actual1440x1000 and375x812: graph/list document width never exceeds viewport without overflow masking. Mobile Close/Escape tested.

loading.reason: Static in-memory fixture has no asynchronous loading or data request.

empty.evidence: Unmatched search yields zero rows and explicit remove-filter guidance.

error.reason: No network/backend operation exists; fake blocked task is explicitly a fixture state, not a real error.

partial.evidence: Instance/type/state filters show a subset; inspector keeps fixture authority labels.

success.evidence: Answer requires choice; local receipt says it was not sent, updates activity with simulated label.

permission.reason: No permission enforcement exists in mockup; all identities/authority are visibly fictional, no server actions.
